$comment: Edits to migrations made while they had never applied in production (a deploy that failed and rolled back). Permanent: entries are never removed or changed. scripts/ci/migrationVersions.mjs accepts an edit only for a listed version whose file has exactly `blob`, and requires `marker` to be text the edit added (in `blob`, not in `base_blob`). scripts/ci/migrationGuard.mjs requires, for every listed version production has applied, that `marker` is among the statements production's ledger recorded, so the edited file is what ran. Read production's ledger before adding an entry.

edits.reason: First deploy failed at DROP VIEW public.view_compliance_stats (42P01) and rolled back: production never had the view (docs/operations/schema-drift-2026-10.md, section 7). Not applied in production on 2026-10-23. Applied with the edit by main's deploy of 0e9cda3 (ledger statements read 2026-10-23).
